title: [review] provisioning.py:491: ProvisioningSession.state
description: The state field in ProvisioningSession is initialized to ProvisioningState.IDLE at line 491/534 but is never updated as the session progresses. The code checks the underlying crypto session's state (br_session.state, node_session.state) at lines 336, 395. The ProvisioningSession.state field is dead code that could confuse maintainers or cause bugs if used.
